description.zh: 汇总模型标识、定价、请求参数、流式输出、工具调用、缓存与 token 计数等细节，并给出模型升级时的迁移提示。适合写调用代码或估算成本之前核对，减少凭记忆猜测。内容来自随附资料，具体数值以官方文档为准。
description.en: Covers model ids, pricing, parameters, streaming, tool use, caching and token counting, with migration notes between versions. Useful for checking facts before writing calls or pricing a feature. Confirm figures against official docs.
